evidence: Actual compiled original ProjectActionMenu callbacks and static JSX with installed QueryClient/QueryObserver. Hook scheduling, portals, confirmation, focus, server state and transport are explicit doubles, not React lifecycle, browser or backend acceptance.
passing_controls: Successful archive sends exactly one original is_archived=true PATCH and calls refresh once.
Cancelled confirmation does not write or refresh.
Held write is busy and disables project settings.
Ordinary invalidateQueries failure does not invoke the archive failure catch after a successful PATCH.
failed_contracts: Confirmed archive remains busy during an actual held query refresh.
Acknowledged canonical response does not update active/include-archived cache scopes.
A rejecting refresh callback replaces confirmed success with an archive failure message; this is a defensive double, not an ordinary GET failure.
Uncertain result has no owner outside a closed/unmounted menu and no read-only check.
Captured callbacks replay uncertain writes and admit duplicate confirmations, including two menu copies.
Missing/archived/default/unavailable targets are not rechecked after confirmation.
Unmounted owner can still submit a resolved old confirmation.
Already archived, failed-read, still-active and localized result-check paths are absent.
